facts.text_en: Morenci is an open-pit copper mining complex in continuous operation since 1939 in Greenlee County, Arizona; the 2015 mill expansion took the concentrator from 50,000 to about 115,000 tonnes of ore per day (Freeport-McMoRan).
facts.text_es: Morenci es un complejo minero de cobre a rajo abierto en operacion continua desde 1939 en el condado de Greenlee, Arizona; la expansion de la planta de 2015 llevo el concentrador de 50.000 a cerca de 115.000 toneladas de mineral por dia (Freeport-McMoRan).

facts.text_en: Ownership: 72% Freeport-McMoRan, 15% Sumitomo Metal Mining Arizona and 13% SMM Morenci; the complex produces copper and molybdenum concentrates and copper cathode from electrowinning (Freeport-McMoRan).
facts.text_es: Propiedad: 72% Freeport-McMoRan, 15% Sumitomo Metal Mining Arizona y 13% SMM Morenci; el complejo produce concentrados de cobre y molibdeno y catodos de cobre por electroobtencion (Freeport-McMoRan).
